## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

- Full local check result and relevant focused checks.
- Browser/device/provider evidence where applicable; distinguish mocks from real execution.
- Remaining limits or failures. A focused pass is not full acceptance.

## Review notes

Mention data/schema changes and preservation requirements when applicable.
Identify third-party source/license notices for new assets or copied code.
Keep credentials, runtime data, model weights and generated outputs out of the PR.
